Category: Monster.

spec.name: Hydra of the Blighted Marsh
spec.description: A five-headed hydra in a God of War style: a scarred, armored Norse-myth beast with a bulky body, four legs, a heavy tail, and five fanged heads on long necks, each with a glowing eye, with chains, runes and broken weapons stuck in its hide.
spec.layout: A low, heavy quadruped body runs along Z, with its chest toward +Z and its tail toward -Z. It stands on four thick, clawed legs, and the claws, feet and belly rest on y=0. Five long S-curved necks rise from the shoulders and fan out in a hand shape. The centre neck is tallest (head at about y=5, z=2.6). Inner pair heads sit at x=+-1.1 (y=4.4, z=2.9). Outer pair heads sit at x=+-2.0 (y=3.3, z=2.4). Heads are blocky wedge skulls with an upper and a lower jaw, big teeth, horns, brow ridges and glowing amber eyes. Style: gritty, desaturated, Norse. Dark green-grey scaled hide has paler belly plates, and cold blue-iron armour plates with rivets are chained onto the shoulders and back. Carved pale-blue glowing runes, scar slashes, broken spear shafts and axe blades stuck in the hide, and bone spikes down the spine give the God of War look. Every colour is a flat colour per part.

parts.builds: The body: a lofted bulky barrel torso from hips to chest in hideDark/hideMid with a hideLight back and a belly-coloured plate underside (rows of belly bands). Scarred slashes in scar colour, bone spikes down the spine, iron shoulder pauldrons and back plates with rivets, chains crossing the chest with iron links, glowing runeBlue runes on the flanks, and broken spear and axe blades stuck in the hide with wood shafts. The five neck bases are muscled shoulder humps at the neckBase mounts.
parts.attaches: Necks start at the neckBase mounts, legs at the shoulder and hip mounts, and the tail at tailBase.

parts.builds: Four thick legs, each a thigh, shin and foot chain in hideDark/hideMid, with iron knee guards, rivets, scale bands, big three-toe feet with claw-coloured claws, and mud/scar details. The heavy tapered tail has bone spikes along its top, a scarred patch, an iron band, and a spiked bone-and-iron club tip. The belly is paler.
parts.attaches: Legs hang from the shoulder and hip mounts, and the tail starts at tailBase.

parts.builds: The centre neck and head, plus the inner left head (headIL): S-curved scaled necks in hideMid with belly stripes on their fronts, iron collars with rivets and chain links, and a ridge of bone spikes. Heads are wedge skulls with an upper jaw and a separate lower jaw bound to the jaw joint, a mouth interior in mouth/tongue colours, rows of bone fangs, horns in horn/bone colours, brow ridges, nostrils and glowing eye parts. The centre head is the biggest, with a broken iron crown/helm and a long scar over one eye. Each head wears one unique detail, such as a cracked horn or an arrow stuck in a cheek.
parts.attaches: Neck chains start at neckBaseC and neckBaseIL on the torso and end at headC and headIL.

parts.builds: The inner right head (headIR) and its neck, in the same style as the centre heads: scaled neck with belly stripes, iron collar and chain, bone spikes, a wedge skull with separate upper and lower jaw, fangs, horns, brow ridges, a glowing eye, and its own unique detail (a notched horn and a snapped spear tip in the jaw). Also the outer right head (headOR) and its neck, sprawling low to the right with an open jaw, an eye scar and an iron muzzle band.
parts.attaches: Necks start at neckBaseIR and neckBaseOR on the torso.

parts.builds: The outer left head (headOL) and its neck, sprawling low to the left in the same head style: a scaled neck with an iron collar and chain, a wedge skull with a separate upper and lower jaw, fangs, horns, a glowing eye, a scar, bone spikes, and one unique detail (a broken axe blade lodged in the neck, a cracked tusk). Also a few extra runeBlue glow runes on its neck and some spare dangling chain loops hung from the shoulders.
parts.attaches: The neck starts at neckBaseOL on the torso.
